## Mathematical corrections made to the interrupted draft (attempt 1)

- **Adjoint/Laplacian local formulas were convention-inconsistent.** With the library's determinant-normalised induced metric (`⟨dz̄,dz̄⟩_g = 2/ρ`) and the conjugate-linear star of Looijenga 3.25 / Demailly (3.3′)–(3.6), the correct formula is `∂̄*(u dz̄⊗e) = −(2/ρψ)∂_z(ψu)e`, not `−(1/ρψ)∂_z(ρψu)e`. Verified twice (weak adjointness and `∂̄⋆ = −⋆∂̄*`), and the draft's version fails the consistency test `⟨Δ″₁u,u⟩ = ‖∂̄*u‖²` for nonconstant weight and would have made item 12's duality false. Symbol and Gårding principal matrix corrected accordingly.
- **∂̄ extended to `(p,q)`-forms** in item 1 (needed by items 5/12); divisor changed to locally finite/finite-on-compact; block domain of `Δ″` fixed; item 12 restated with `F = K⊗E*` (the page's own vocabulary) instead of an undefined `H^{1,0}(E*)`; B-page wording aligned.
- **Axiom bookkeeping:** items 4–12 and the five examples carry AC (via the published Sobolev-localisation/compactness/Fredholm suppliers), with the exact use named; item 1 and 3 stay choice-free, item 2 keeps Countable Choice only.
